description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

B4Corp is hiring a Software Engineer to support a customer’s web, mobile, and interactive products. The role delivers end-to-end human-centered design and application development, including user research, prototyping, usability testing, and accessibility compliance.
Software Engineer building web and mobile products through human-centered design, user research, accessibility audits, and usability testing

Responsibilities:
• Shall manage project priorities and tasks to ensure accuracy and timeliness, clarity of message, and quality control for products
• Shall meet Sponsor’s requirements for quality, responsiveness, and accessibility
• Shall comply with Sponsor development standards and deliver end-to-end human-centered design (HCD) services for web applications, and software products
• Shall lead research, interaction design, visual design, and usability testing to ensure compliance with federal standards, and accessible digital experiences
• Shall update assigned project statuses in Sponsor’s production tracking tool
• Shall design systems and to support interactive and mobile production, web applications, and websites
• Shall ensure compliance with Section 508 of the Rehabilitation Act (36 CFR Part 1194) / WCAG 2.1 Level AA standards
• Shall conduct User Research & Discovery, planning and conducting qualitative and quantitative user research, stakeholder interviews, persona development, and journey mapping
• Shall use best practices of Information Architecture (IA) and develop wireframes, sitemaps, task flows, and navigation models to streamline complex administrative workflows
• Shall create high-fidelity mockups, scalable design systems, and interactive prototypes using authorized design software
• Shall perform regular usability testing sessions, expert evaluations, and automated and manual 508 accessibility audits
• Shall partner with development teams, product owners, and accessibility SMEs to ensure feasibility and compliance throughout the development lifecycle
• Shall advise and assist the project team in the development of process documentation to support individual tasks, knowledge sharing, and development process workflows
• Shall maintain and modify existing designs to correct errors, adapt to new hardware, or improve performance
• Shall review existing programs and assist in making refinements, reducing operating time, and improve current techniques
• Shall store, retrieve, and manipulate data to enhance user experience and leverage system capabilities or requirements
• Shall be tasked with building web-based interactive, web, and mobile products as needed
• Shall provide data transfer support to team members as needed

Requirements:
• Position Requires a Top Secret (TS/SCI) Clearance with a Polygraph
• Demonstrated experience of user-centered design principles, human-computer interaction, and user research methodologies
• Demonstrated experience with visual design, interaction design, and UI design principles, including typography, color theory, and layout
• Demonstrated experience with design tools such as Figma, Illustrator, Photoshop or Adobe XO
• Demonstrated experience in creating interactive prototypes and conducting usability testing to validate design decisions
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills to effectively collaborate with cross-functional teams, stakeholders, and clients
• Demonstrated experience with version control software including Git and GitHub
• Demonstrated experience with presentational development including HTML5/CSS3, Hugo or other static site generators (please specify), and SASS
• Demonstrated experience with functional development including Javascript, Angular, and React
• Demonstrated experience with accessibility guidelines and best practices to ensure inclusive design

Preferred:
• Demonstrated experience with design operations, including design project management, design tooling, and design workflow optimization
• Demonstrated experience in developing and maintaining design systems, including creating and managing design languages and component libraries
• Demonstrated experience supporting system security documentation
• Demonstrated experience with mobile mapping capabilities and charting
